findings.evidence: Only evals/test-scenarios.md: three narrative agent-run anecdotes (baseline RED, GREEN, pressure) plus a loophole note. No evals/evals.json with prompts, expected output and verifiable assertions, and no evals/trigger-queries.json.
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with at least three realistic prompts (casual, precise, and the mixed Required: escalation edge) plus expected Fix Summary status and assertions (zero edits on any escalation trigger; no unflagged sections changed), and evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 queries, 8-10 should-trigger and 8-10 should-not-trigger including near-misses such as writing a review report or implementing the design.

findings.evidence: This is a process skill: a fixed sequence — read, checklist, edit-or-escalate per finding, summarize — not a body of standing knowledge to browse.
findings.fix: Delete the self-classification sentence; the steps below already show the sequence.

findings.evidence: Do not edit the review report itself. | Report is read-only input.
findings.fix: Keep the rule once, in Common Mistakes, and drop the table row that only restates it.

findings.evidence: A finding's Location: spans or affects more than one document ... Edits addressing such findings must be applied consistently across all affected documents in a single pass — do not partially fix one document and leave the other inconsistent.
findings.fix: Move the cross-document case out of the stop-and-don't-edit list into its own branch: edit every named document in one pass, or escalate the whole finding if any document is missing; do not list it under Stop and ask the caller (don't edit).

findings.evidence: ## Common Mistakes restates the Editing rules table (scope, new features, silent drop, report, re-evaluate, reformat, unread file, partial fix) without a Gotchas section.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas list of facts the rules do not state: inline document content is refused even when the report is inline; MEDIUM stays a task only when the edit is a wording change inside Location:; disagreement still requires the edit plus a skipped-list note.

findings.evidence: description names the checklist report, CRITICAL/HIGH, framework profile and Fix Summary, but not the review-report path, Required:/Location: fields, or the neighbor it must not do (authoring the review).
findings.fix: Use when a review report from ai-kit-spec-review-checklist, or an equivalent report with Severity, Location and Required fields, is already on disk and the design or plan document must be edited in place: address every CRITICAL and HIGH finding, keep the framework profile's requirement syntax, and emit a Fix Summary. Trigger even when the user says apply the review, fix the findings, or dispatch the fixer, without naming this skill. Not for writing or grading the review report, and not for implementing the design in code.

findings.evidence: ### Worked example inlines one finding, the edit and the summary line inside the 115-line body; nothing else is deferred.
findings.fix: Move the worked example to references/example-fix.md and gate it: read it only when the first summary line is hard to shape; do not load it for a routine single-location wording fix.

findings.evidence: MEDIUM findings are tasks if trivial; otherwise they are escalation candidates.
findings.fix: Default: address a MEDIUM finding only when the edit is a wording change inside its Location: and needs no new claim; otherwise defer it under Findings not yet addressed. Escalate a MEDIUM only when it matches an escalation condition.

findings.evidence: Escalation conditions say stop and don't edit when Location spans more than one document, then in the same bullet require edits on all affected documents in a single pass.
findings.fix: Split the branch: if every affected document path is on disk, edit them all in one pass and list each under Findings addressed; if any path is missing or the Required outcomes conflict, escalate the whole finding and set Status: Escalation Required with no edits.

findings.evidence: If you disagree with a finding, do NOT silently ignore it. Address it AND note your disagreement in the output summary.
findings.fix: State the output slot: put the performed edit under Findings addressed and the one-sentence disagreement under Findings skipped, and never use skipped alone for a finding you also edited.
